basics.name: Jorge González Ozorno
basics.label: Full Stack Developer
basics.bio: Full Stack Developer building internal platforms, AI assistants, and release automation at Ford.
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer building scalable web platforms, AI assistants, and automated release pipelines. Led the modernization of Ford's PDPO Portal and Knowledge Base, delivering a production RAG assistant used across both platforms and removing manual versioning and release work. Computer Science graduate of Tecnológico de Monterrey with a 4.0 GPA and winner of a national hackathon.

work.name: Ford Motor Company
work.summary: Owned the PDPO Portal and Knowledge Base, internal platforms serving Ford's 3DEXPERIENCE product development users.
highlights: Designed and launched a production AI assistant and RAG agent platform with Google ADK and Vertex AI, now used in both the Portal and Knowledge Base and planned for reuse by other teams.
Migrated the Knowledge Base from MkDocs to Zensical and added a FastAPI and Uvicorn runtime, turning a static site into a platform with authentication, sessions, and APIs.
Automated calendar versioning and releases for 2 applications with GitHub Actions, shipping 5 monthly and 3 patch releases with zero manual versioning or release notes.
Rebuilt the Portal from legacy HTML into a Next.js and Spring Boot application with live LDAP team directories and an Elastic Synthetics health dashboard for 3 environments.
Enforced repository standards and strict build validation, eliminating about 1 hour per week of broken link cleanup, and mentored contributors through 18+ support issues.

work.name: Ford Motor Company
highlights: Migrated legacy financial applications from Linux shell and SQL scripts to Google Cloud Platform, rebuilding them with Spring Boot and Angular.
Maintained code quality and security with Tekton, SonarQube, and FOSSA through testing, change approval, and production deployment.
work.summary: Completed Ford's IT Academy program in Java full stack development on Google Cloud.

work.name: El Puerto de Liverpool
highlights: Automated financial processes with UiPath and Visual Basic robots, reducing processing time by up to 60%.
Automated SAP ECC and S/4HANA data extraction and Excel data management.

work.name: Daimler Truck Mexico
highlights: Built dynamic SQL and Microsoft Report Builder reports tailored to materials analysts and expeditors.
Led the frontend rebuild of the gift drive app with React and Tailwind, adding QR code scanning that tracked 1,341 gifts for 450 children.
Automated extraction of children's wishlists from PDFs with Python, replacing manual data entry for volunteers.
